'''Lumbridge Castle''' is a large castle located in [[Lumbridge]] and home of [[Duke Horacio]]. The courtyard enclosed by the outer walls features two decorative fountains and two statues, one of an ancient king and one of an ancient hero. A short flight of three steps joins this to the castle's front entrance. Another entrance is behind the castle.

The [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] and [[Lumbridge Teleport]] [[spells]] take players to the courtyard of the castle.

It is a popular location as many new players are here, as they [[Spawning|spawn]] here after completing [[Tutorial Island]]. Players also respawn here after [[death]], although it it possible to change your [[respawn point]] and respawn elsewhere.

==Features==
==={{FloorNumber|uk=0|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
The {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} is home to various water sources, a [[Cooking]] [[range]] that has a lower rate of burning certain foods, various decorations such as a long table and many portraits, and two quests: [[Cook's Assistant]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]]. In order to use the range, players must finish Cook's Assistant. A single mind rune spawn can be found by the [[Staircase (Lumbridge Castle)|stairs]] on the southern side of the castle. 

The Cook's Assistant and Recipe for Disaster [[quest]]s can be started here by talking to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]] in the kitchen on the main floor. A trapdoor in the kitchen leads down to a cellar containing [[bucket]] and [[knife]] spawns, and an entrance to the [[Dorgeshuun Mines]].

==={{FloorNumber|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
The {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} is where [[Duke Horacio]]'s bedroom is and where he spends much of his time. Players can start the [[Rune Mysteries]] [[quest]] by speaking with him. He also provides a free [[anti-dragon shield]] to any player who has started the [[Dragon Slayer I]] quest. [[Sigmund]], his advisor, is the starting point of [[The Lost Tribe]].
There is a [[spinning wheel]] in the room next to Duke Horacio and [[Cadmus]], the [[Crafting]] tutor. The spinning wheel is one of the most used spinning wheels in ''Old School RuneScape'' due to its proximity to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} [[Lumbridge Castle bank|bank]].

==={{FloorNumber|uk=2|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
The {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} has a [[Lumbridge Castle bank|bank]]. There are also 4 [[logs|log]] spawns, great for beginners training [[Firemaking]] and [[Fletching]].

===Cellar===
The cellar can be accessed by climbing down a [[trapdoor (Lumbridge Castle)|trapdoor]] located in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. Before either the [[Recipe for Disaster]] or [[The Lost Tribe]] quests, this floor has only a [[cabbage]], two [[leather boots]], a [[jug]], a [[knife]], a [[bucket]], and a broom leaning against a portrait. After beginning the Recipe for Disaster quest, players will have access to the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]], which includes a [[bank]]. Additionally, after the Lost Tribe quest, players gain direct access to the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]].

==Treasure Trails==
*Searching a crate in the cellar is the solution to a hard [[cryptic clue]]: ''You will need to under-cook to solve this one.''
